_doc: Per-product Tesco listing overrides + constants. Edited by the /tesco-shopify-shape skill, read by scripts/mirakl_bq_to_tesco.py and scripts/tesco_csv_batch.py. Tesco categories ARE the Shopify product taxonomy; attribute schema is API-discoverable via /products/attributes?hierarchy=<gid>.

exclude_skus.C-SP22144: No sellable Tesco leaf for a trailer (2026-06-09)

attribute_extras._doc: Extra Tesco attribute values to inject into rows. Shape: {attrCode: {SKU_or_'*': value}}. '*' applies to every product; a SKU key wins over '*'. Use for category-specific required attrs (e.g. batterySize) that aren't auto-filled.

attribute_mappings._doc: Shopify-source → Tesco-attribute mappings that auto-fill OPTIONAL spec fields (Cutting Width, Bulletpoints, dimensions, Power Source, etc.) so listings are rich, not bare. Scoped by Tesco category gid, or '*' for all. Shape: {<gid|'*'>: {<tescoAttrCode>: {source, transform}}}. Keys are Tesco attribute CODES (not portal labels) — get them from `tesco_shopify_shape.py list-attributes`. Sources: metafield:<ns.key>, display_attribute:<code>, field:<title|vendor>, weight, const:<value>. Transforms: dim_value | dim_unit | weight_value | weight_unit | list_first | list_join | strip_html | bullet:N | (omit for raw). Category-scoped mappings win over '*'. Managed by /tesco-shopify-shape.
